node.title: Re^3: Mojo::DOM find tag after another tag
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Hi [luxs],

Since I'm guessing the tags can be nested arbitrarily deep, the CSS selector "img, h1" was going to be my next suggestion.

There are many other ways to write the logic, here's one:

use warnings; use strict; use Mojo::DOM; my $data = <<'ENDDATA'; yada...yada...yada.. yada...yada...yada.. yada...yada...yada..

Some title

yada...yada...yada.. yada...yada...yada.. ENDDATA my $dom = Mojo::DOM->new($data); my (@imgs,$seen_h1); for my $tag ( $dom->find('h1, img')->each ) { if ($seen_h1 && $tag->tag eq 'img' && length $tag->attr('src')) { push @imgs, $tag } elsif ($tag->tag eq 'h1') { $seen_h1 = 'true' } } print $_->attr('src'),"\n" for @imgs; __END__ 333 444

You don't even need the intermediate @imgs array and can [doc://print] directly from the first loop if you like.

Hope this helps,
-- Hauke D
